brief:
Israeli occupation forces demolished a memorial erected for slain residents of Madama village, south of Nablus, the Ma'an news agency reported. The structure, known as a shrine to the village's martyrs, was destroyed during an operation by the military.

The demolition marks another instance of Israeli forces targeting Palestinian commemorative sites in the occupied West Bank. Madama has been a flashpoint for Israeli-Palestinian tensions in recent years.
title: Israeli forces demolish Madama martyrs' memorial south of Nablus
